formal_voice.expression: RegistryContext = (Context, RegisteredSelectionPolicy, Resolver); Resolve(Request, RegistryContext) -> View | Blocked
invariants: Context identity and Context digest are checked before any View is produced.
Every selected record is named by a registered selection ID and checked against its exact digest.
A View preserves Context identity but is not the Context.
Resolution has authority_effect none and cannot mutate a source.

definitions.plain_language_voice: A Registry Context is a named Context that can be read through a checked registry, so a consumer gets the right bounded meaning without searching or guessing.
definitions.domain_context_voice: In CyberAlchemy v2, Registry Context supplies Define, Language, Project, Goal, and later capabilities with exact Context Views while each source and owner keeps its authority.
lifecycle: register a Context identity and its allowed exact selections
receive a request naming the Context and expected digest
produce one immutable View or block
supersede registration when a material Context anchor changes
definitions.owner_route: CyberAlchemy v2 Context product owner plus CyberAlchemy v2 Registry Context runtime owner
definitions.forbidden_collapse: Registry Context is not a Bounded Context, Request, View, Snapshot, Project, session, source registry, service process, or authority grant.
